retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic equine scene featuring horses galloping through shallow water with a vertical mirror reflection and a dual-layered typographic hierarchy.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five wild horses galloping from left to right through shallow, misty water. The lead horse is prominent on the left, with the others trailing in a staggered line. The water surface creates a clear, slightly distorted vertical reflection of the horses. The lighting is soft and atmospheric, with a warm central glow suggesting a rising or setting sun behind a haze of blue and grey mist.
coreVisualRelationships: Horses positioned in the middle third of the vertical frame
Symmetrical relationship between the horses and their water reflections
Contrast between the sharp equine forms and the soft, hazy background
Typographic balance between a wide-tracked top header and a centered ornate script
coreInvariants: Soft blue-grey and pale yellow color palette
Dual typography: wide sans-serif and ornate script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The horses occupy the horizontal center, scaled to leave significant negative space above and below for text and reflections.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lead horse on the left, which is the largest and most detailed figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Left-to-right horizontal motion of the horses, countered by the verticality of the reflections and the centered text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive misty sky at the top and watery foreground at the bottom provide breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and charcoal equine coats
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft amber/yellow glow in the center background
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the center, creating a luminous, ethereal effect.

letterConstructionRules: Central logo uses high-contrast thick and thin strokes with elaborate swashes
Script flourishes are interconnected and fluid
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters in the script have oversized, circular loops
The ampersand is integrated into the script flow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a rigid, widely-spaced sans-serif and a dense, fluid calligraphic script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along the top edge

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, formal swashed script look.
Provides the geometric, clean skeleton for the wide-tracked top line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an oil painting of five horses galloping through shallow water in a misty blue-grey environment with a soft yellow sun glow in the center. Include clear vertical reflections of the horses in the water. Leave the top 25% of the frame as empty misty sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of all-caps sans-serif text across the very top with extreme letter spacing. Below that, in the upper center, add two lines of ornate, high-contrast calligraphic script with large swashes.

verificationChecks: Is the top text extremely wide-tracked?
Are the horses reflected vertically in the water?
Is the script text centered and ornate?
Is the color palette muted and atmospheric?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the central sun glow
Tracking width of the top text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the reflections align vertically with the horses
Check that the top text does not touch the script text
Verify the mist obscures the horizon line
Confirm the script flourishes are elegant and not messy
recipe.reuseFormula: Equine motion + vertical reflection + atmospheric mist + (wide-tracked sans-serif / ornate script) typographic pairing.
